name: The Queen Anne`s Revenge
description: Queen Anne's Revenge: Originally named Concorde, Concorde of Nantes, it was later renamed Queen Anne's Revenge by Blackbeard. This legendary ship, known across the seven seas, struck fear into the hearts of pirates on the high seas and was rumored to have sailed laden with riches and treasures stolen from its unfortunate victims. Captain Blackbeard is one of the most famous pirates in the history of world navigation. His deeds have been adapted into various movies and TV shows, such as the movie "Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides" and the comic "One Piece".
